description:
Propose relationships between people or organisations that a record states,
    such as a marriage or parent and child in a family register.

    Each side must be an existing authority record (give its id from
    search_authorities) or a person or organisation you have already proposed
    for this record with propose_access_points_and_dates. Give the line that
    states each relationship as evidence. An archivist reviews them in AI >
    Relationship review; approved ones show on both authority records. Needs
    the archivist's own staff key.

date.description: When it held, as written, e.g. "married 2 May 1898" or "1898-1949".
date.title: Date

end_date.description: End as YYYY-MM-DD, only when the exact day is known.
end_date.title: End Date

evidence.description: The line in the record, or the source, that states it.
evidence.title: Evidence

object_existing_id.description: Id from search_authorities when the object already has an authority record.
object_existing_id.title: Object Existing Id

relation.description: How the subject relates to the object, read "subject relation object".
relation.title: Relation

sources.description: URLs of web sources used, if any.
sources.title: Sources

start_date.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DD, only when the exact day is known.
start_date.title: Start Date

subject.description: The first person or organisation, as proposed for this record or as named in the catalogue.
subject.title: Subject

subject_existing_id.description: Id from search_authorities when the subject already has an authority record.
subject_existing_id.title: Subject Existing Id

name: propose_relationships
